steps.title: Distance myth
steps.say: Actually, Earth is closest to the Sun in January, during northern winter! Distance does not cause the seasons.

steps.title: Summer tilt
steps.say: You dragged Earth to northern summer: notice the northern hemisphere tilts toward the Sun, receiving direct sunlight and longer days.

steps.title: Try dragging again
steps.say: Explore how the tilt changes sunlight and seasons across the year by dragging the Earth around its orbit.
